		NOT = { has_global_variable = wtp_half }
		global_var:wtp_half = 1
		global_var:wtp_half = 3
	}
}

wtp_building_available_weapon_guild = {
	OR = {
		has_global_variable = wtp_realm_has_coal
		has_global_variable = wtp_realm_has_gems
		has_global_variable = wtp_realm_has_lumber
		has_global_variable = wtp_realm_has_stone
	}
}
wtp_building_unlocked_weapon_guild = {
	can_build_building = building_type:weapon_guild
	NOT = { building_type_is_obsolete = building_type:weapon_guild }
}
# weapon_guild is staffed by burghers
wtp_building_in_scope_weapon_guild = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = wtp_half }
		global_var:wtp_half = 1
		global_var:wtp_half = 2
	}
}
